ns2:section.sectionText: Title: US Work Class Topic: This course will examine the history of work and working people in the United States. Major themes will include the labor politics of gender, race, and immigration, and the impact of workers’ movements on the history of U.S. popular culture. Readings will include landmark texts in labor history as well as examples of emerging new scholarship in the field. Students will have the opportunity to work with a range of primary sources, including materials from our campus library’s extraordinary collections in U.S. labor history. The course will culminate in a major research paper.
